title: Senior Data Engineer (SQL DBA)
description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

We are hiring for a Senior Data Engineer (SQL DBA) at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure you are aligned with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge-case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full-time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands-on environment and grow into long-term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization.

title: Communications Technician
description:
Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators.

Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra‑low latency and fiber‑like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world.

The company’s state‑of‑the‑art Satellite fleet consists of 14 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat‑1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit

Reporting to the Manager, Satellite Operations, the Communications Technician performs real time Telemetry, Track and Control (TTC) of all satellites operated by Telesat Brazil and monitors ground systems according to established procedures and policies; is responsible for all aspects of successful in‑orbit mission operations; serves as an interface to internal and external customers, as it relates to the daily transponder accesses; and is responsible for the overall ground station or facilities operations.

Responsibilities: Satellite In‑Orbit Operations

  • Monitor all in‑orbit satellite performance.
  • Provide routine operations to maintain the satellite orbit and subsystems health.
  • Provide emergency system operations in accordance with contingency plans;
  • Respond immediately to all anomalous events and/or alarms;
  • Prepare anomaly reports to engineers for further investigation;
  • Operate, configure and monitor satellite subsystems, including: Power, Thermal, Reaction Control, Attitude, TTC, and Communications;
  • Perform station keeping maneuvers, battery reconditioning, eclipse operations, and other routine operations;
  • Maintain and operate ground station TTC equipment: Antenna Control Units, Command, Ranging and Telemetry racks, and Command Encryption modules;
  • Maintain and operate front‑end processors and associated computers;
  • Conduct special satellite testing as directed by satellite engineering/management.

Responsibilities: Customer Service Operations

  • Answer incoming calls from Uplinkers, Customers, and persons requesting information.
  • Perform Uplinker performance checks and transponder‑access tests, including Transponder frequency, Polarization, Deviation, and Power. Correlate power/polarization level adjustments with field technicians.
  • Monitor consoles, maintain event logs, and enter information into databases.
  • Perform troubleshooting of reported video and audio troubles using appropriate test equipment.
  • Identify and accelerate service outages and abnormal conditions.
  • Assist other technicians during busy times and provide relief during breaks and lunch periods.
  • Respond to all customer trouble calls and inquiries - initiate, review, update, and clear trouble tickets.
  • Coordinate customer booking problems and transponder service extensions with Telesat Engineering.
  • Perform satellite and transponder restorations as directed by the restoration plans.
  • Assist Engineering and customer Field Engineers as requested.
  • Perform in‑service ‘Console Transponder Calibration’ tests using supplied hardware/software.
  • Setup consoles and monitor audio teleconferencing bridges for satellite news feeds.
  • Perform calibration tests on spectrum analyzers and other equipment used in the Service Assurance Center (SAC).
  • Coordinate customer additions and disconnects as directed by scheduled Service Orders.
  • Coordinate satellite transponder change requests as directed by Engineering.
  • Isolate and resolve satellite transponder interferences.
  • Perform certification tests for all new digital uplinkers.

Responsibilities: Ground Station/Facilities Operations

  • Operate, configure and monitor ground station subsystems, including: Electric, Air Conditioning, Communications, IT;
  • Maintain and operate ground station equipment: Antennas, RF, IF, Communications, test equipment;
  • Record all significant customer activities or internal events in the station log;
  • Maintain and update facility site documentation;
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance;
  • Prepare Performance Analysis reports, as requested by engineering/management;
  • Develop, maintain and distribute daily reports, operational shift logs and trouble ticket database to appropriate individuals on a needed basis;
  • Prepare and distribute (E‑mail) daily reports;
  • File completed logs;
  • Perform shipping, ordering, handling, inventory, and testing of on‑line and spare parts;
  • Monitor building, fire, and security systems.
  • Handle on‑call, special and In‑Charge assignments

Education and Experience required

  • Technical specialization (Certified Technician) on Telecommunications or Electronics.
  • Ability to write, read and speak on both English and Portuguese languages.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals;
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence;
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

Decision making and Supervision

  • Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action;
  • Receives instructions on new assignments or projects;
  • Actively seeks information and guidance to improve own performance.
  • There is no staff reporting to this position.

Working conditions

  • 12 x 36 (or similar) shift work
  • Working onsite in office
  • Occasional travel
  • Occasional visits to customer sites

At Telesat, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer that values equality in the workplace. We are committed to providing the best candidate experience possible including any required accommodations at every stage of our interview process. All qualified applicants that have been selected for an interview that require accommodations, are advised to inform the Telesat Talent team accordingly. We will work with you to meet your needs. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential.

title: Business Intelligence
description:
At Maersk Supply Service, Business Intelligence is more than dashboards and reports—it is about turning data into insight that supports better decisions across the business. We are looking for a Business Intelligence professional who can translate complex data into clear, actionable insights, supporting strategic decisions, performance management, and operational excellence in a dynamic offshore environment.

If you are motivated by data‑driven decision making and value openness, collaboration, and transparent communication, we would love to hear from you.

Who we are

We are more than a supply service company—we are a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you will join a close‑knit and collaborative team, working closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Finance, and Operations.

You will collaborate with colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their expertise to help navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do. Our work environment is flexible, energized, and inclusive. Ideas are not only heard—they are valued. We celebrate diversity and believe that \"we\" comes before \"I\". Through close collaboration, continuous learning, and mutual respect, we create a space where your voice matters and your contributions drive real impact.

What You Will Be Doing

The Business Intelligence role sits at the core of our Finance organisation and plays a key role in enabling informed decision making across the business.

In this role, you will support strategic and operational decisions by ensuring leadership and key stakeholders have access to reliable, structured, and meaningful insights. Your work will support performance tracking, forecasting, planning, and ad‑hoc analysis—helping the organisation understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what actions to take.

You will be responsible for collecting, structuring, and analysing data from multiple internal and external sources, transforming raw data into intuitive dashboards, visualisations, and reports that support leadership discussions and business execution.

title: Content Services Liaison Manager
description:
Content Services Liaison Manager

Department: Partnerships & Media

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Content Services Liaison Manager will report jointly to the Zurich-based FWWC Content Services Project Lead. The successful candidate will be responsible for the planning and coordination of all event-related video content production, as well as ensuring the successful delivery of pre-event and in-tournament video content to FIFA stakeholders.

The Content Services Liaison Manager will be the in-country point of contact for all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives or stadium authorities and FIFA’s Media Partners in relation to non-live content services.

The successful individual will work closely with the FIFA Content Services team at FIFA HQ, Zurich to develop content strategies for the event, as well as communicating the confirmed content plans (long-form, short-form, social, audio) to all relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include 1 year to go, the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, 100 days to go and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and long operational hours. The selected candidate will also be expected to elevate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee all pre-event content production based on the overall tournament content-plan developed in close collaboration with the FIFA Content Services Team in Zurich.
  • Ensure all content creation and delivery for the tournament is communicated clearly and promoted to all stakeholders.
  • Liaise with the FIFA team in Zurich around the creation and distribution of all future content. Report all developments to the Head of Production and work closely with all areas of the FIFA content team.
  • Liaise closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts to ensure they are informed about and engaged with all filming projects and that their individual content requirements are taken care of.
  • Potentially liaise with the North- and South American Media Partners (MP) to coordinate the delivery of produced content, discuss long and short-form programming opportunities and social media packages and assets – to be done in conjunction with FIFA Zurich.
  • Investigate new North and South American based opportunities around potential long and short-form programming, branded content, social media and audio projects, including podcasts.
  • Lead weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, manage and resolve risks and issues for FWWC content services related topics within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Content Services Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Work across multiple time zones, to support the FIFA Content Services Project Lead based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office.
  • Work closely with the local Host Broadcast and Media Partnerships department as their main point of contact for any FIFA Content Services related topics.
  • Pre-plan, onsite support and supervision of the content production for the Play off Final tournaments, the Final Draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • A strong background in editorial sports television production or sports television production management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a producer or production manager in a comparable content production related role within a fast-paced environment involving complex projects – ideally at a similar international sports event.
  • A knowledge of and participation in the South American Sports TV industry.
  • Contacts within the national football associations in South America.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organization.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Highly organized and proven to be cool‑headed under pressure.
  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

Otimizar as alavancas da categoria de coloração para a Divisão de Grande Público, analisar os dados de mercado e recomendar os planos de ação por marca, canal e região. Principais Atividades

  • Estratégia e Análise de Categoria

    • Desenvolver apresentação para os JBPs com foco nas suas marcas de coloração.
    • Realizar análises aprofundadas de dados de mercado e vendas para identificar oportunidades e desafios para as marcas de Coloração sob sua responsabilidade na visão de canais e regiões.

  • Ativação de Vendas e Trade Marketing

    • Liderar a criação de direcionais para os planos de ativação das suas marcas alinhados com a estratégia de vendas e marketing.
    • Otimizar o sortimento de produtos de coloração nos diferentes canais de venda, garantindo a disponibilidade e visibilidade adequadas.
    • Desenvolver materiais de ponto de venda e ferramentas de vendas que suportem a equipe de campo e varejistas.
    • Gerenciar promoções e atividades de trade marketing para impulsionar as vendas e a experimentação dos produtos de coloração.

  • Relacionamento e Colaboração

    • Construir e manter fortes relacionamentos com as equipes de vendas, marketing, trade marketing e clientes/varejistas.
    • Atuar como ponto focal da categoria de coloração para as equipes de vendas, fornecendo insights e suporte para as marcas de sua responsabilidade.

  • Conhecimento do Consumidor e Mercado

    • Aprofundar o conhecimento sobre o shopper de produtos de coloração no segmento de Grande Público, traduzindo insights em ações concretas.
    • Desenvolver uma visão clara para a categoria, comunicando-a eficazmente para as partes interessadas.

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Stakeholder management: Capacidade de gerenciar e influenciar diversas partes interessadas.
  • Category growth management: Expertise em impulsionar o crescimento da categoria.
  • Category vision: Visão estratégica para a categoria de produtos.
  • Data-driven decision making: Orientação para decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Engaging selling to customers / retailers: Habilidade em engajar clientes e varejistas para vendas.
  • Finance literacy: Compreensão básica de finanças para análise de rentabilidade.
  • Shopper intelligence: Entendimento profundo do comportamento do comprador.
  • Customer / retailer value proposition: Habilidade em criar propostas de valor para clientes e varejistas.
  • Possibilidades de crescimentos, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

Estamos empenhados em garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e em defender a contratação e promoção de cada candidato de forma ética e equitativa.

O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei.

Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.

  • Participate daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure you are aligned with business needs.

  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non‑technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership.

Additional Information

About Stranger Soccer

With 3.5 billion football enthusiasts in over 200 countries, football is the most popular sport in the world. But why don't more people play it? Stranger Soccer ( makes playing football as easy as going for a jog or to the gym. Browse dozens of games on its acclaimed Mobile App. Book a slot. Turn up and play. Whether you call it Fussball, Fútbol, Calcio, or anything else, the world now awaits.

To make playing football as easy as going for a jog.

A world in which playing football is as popular and widespread as watching football.

title: Market Intelligence
description:
At Maersk Supply Service, Market Intelligence is more than reporting—it’s what helps us win smarter in offshore markets. We’re looking for someone who can turn market and competitor insights into commercial actions—supporting strategy, bids/tenders, and clear decisions in a fast-moving vessel supply/demand landscape. If you value openness, collaboration, and transparent communication, we’d love to hear from you.

Who we are

We’re more than a supply service company—we’re a team of people who genuinely care about doing things right. Based in Rio de Janeiro, you’ll be welcomed into a close-knit Commercial team that thrives on collaboration, open dialogue, and mutual respect. You’ll work alongside colleagues from across the organisation, each bringing their own expertise to help us navigate the complexities of the energy sector with integrity, safety, and purpose.

We enjoy what we do! We have a flexible and energized work environment. Here, ideas are not just heard—they’re valued. We celebrate our diverse backgrounds and see them as a true source of strength. We work close together, humbling listening and learning from each other, and overcoming challenges together, “we” should come before “I”. Every day, we strive to create a supportive space where your voice matters and your contributions lead to real change. This role is a unique blend of operational excellence and human connection.

What You Will Be Doing

The Market Intelligence position sits at the core of our Commercial organisation and plays a critical role in shaping how we understand its markets and makes strategic decisions. In this role, your work will directly support commercial strategy, sales planning, and leadership decision‑making—ensuring the business has a clear, fact‑based view of where to compete and how to win.

You will be a key contributor to building and maintaining a strong, shared understanding of offshore market dynamics, including market size, market shares, competitor positioning, and vessel supply. By continuously analysing how and why these factors evolve over time, you will help the organisation anticipate change rather than react to it. You will translate complex data into clear insights that guide strategic priorities.

A key focus during your first six months will be collecting, structuring, and analysing annual market data that forms the foundation for our global sales plan and regional commercial strategies. You will also play an important role in enabling data‑driven decision‑making by developing intuitive data visualisations, dashboards, and business intelligence tools that support leadership discussions and commercial execution. Ensuring the quality, relevance, and effective use of market databases and external subscriptions will be part of your responsibility, helping the organisation rely on robust and trusted sources.

Who You Are

First and foremost, you are curious about markets and motivated by understanding how data, trends, and insights shape commercial strategy and business decisions. You enjoy working at the intersection of analysis and collaboration, building trusted relationships with stakeholders, and translating complex information into clear, actionable insights that support growth and competitiveness in the offshore market:

  • Proficiency in verbal and written English and Portuguese.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economy or related areas.
  • MBA in Business or Finance will be considered a plus for this position.
  • You have 2–5 years of experience from a similar role within the Oil & Gas market, giving you a solid understanding of market dynamics, commercial drivers, and competitive landscape.
  • You are highly comfortable working with large and complex datasets and integrating data from multiple sources. You have strong hands‑on experience with tools such as Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint, and you enjoy turning raw data into structured insights.
  • You can translate market data, research, and trends into meaningful input for commercial strategy, sales planning, and leadership decision‑making, always keeping the business context in mind.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling you to present analyses, conclusions, and recommendations in a clear, concise, and structured manner, with strong attention to detail.
  • You thrive in a dynamic and fast‑paced environment, are comfortable working independently, and at the same time enjoy being a collaborative team player who contributes positively to shared goals.

How to Apply

If you can imagine yourself in this role, we look very much forward to hearing from you. Please apply through our website no later than 17 April 2026. We will review and interview on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Research and Analysis:

  • Build relationships with clients and stakeholders to deeply understand their pain points and vision
  • Conduct primary and secondary research (such as user interviews, persona analysis, customer journey mapping) to gain deep insights into consumer behaviour, market trends, and competitive landscapes.
  • Stay updated on consumer research, industry trends, and emerging market shifts to inform brand strategies.
  • Analyze research findings, data, and trends to uncover insights, challenges, and opportunities that shape holistic and effective brand strategies.

  • Collaborate with the strategy team to develop brand messaging, positioning, and strategy that align with user-centered design principles, target audiences, and market analysis,
  • Present and articulate strategic thinking and engage with clients to get buy-in and understand feedback.
  • Collaborate with Design Directors to ensure seamless integration of brand strategies into visual identities, sitemap and user flows.

Collaboration with Stakeholders:

  • Collaborate with clients, project managers, designers, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals and requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather input, address concerns, and make informed decisions.
  • Maintain effective communication channels to keep stakeholders updated on project progress and strategy development.

Brand Content Strategy and Messaging:

  • Transform brand strategies into messaging pillars that resonate with the priority audiences.
  • Provide data-driven content strategies that increase user engagement and elevate digital experiences.
  • Collaborate and guide the Copy team to develop copy that resonate with the client's brand.
  • Adapt communication styles and channels to effectively reach and engage different stakeholders.

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.

Analista de Planejamento e Controle de Produção SR (PCP) irá gerenciar o abastecimento de matérias primas e materiais de embalagem da fábrica e controlar o nível de inventario com trabalho local em CHSC, interface principal com as áreas de Almoxarifado, Compras e Qualidade.

  • Realizar o planejamento e colocação de ordens de materiais aos fornecedores (MRP);
  • Monitorar janela de entrega de materiais com almoxarifado e fornecedores;
  • Analisar e atuar riscos de abastecimento;
  • Priorizar liberação de materiais com o time de qualidade;
  • Reduzir o nível de obsoletos realizando o esgotamento ideal de matérias em mudança ou a vencer;
  • Implementar novos materiais dentro do prazo;
  • Manter uma política de estoque de materiais adequada;
  • Analisar o inventário de materiais mantendo um nível adequado baseado na política definida e ferramenta de projeção de estoque;
  • Liderar CAPAs e auditorias da área;
  • Liderar os projetos de melhorias e apresentar os resultados com planos de ações e medições de perfomance;
  • Garantir a integridade de dados e parâmetros atualizados nos sistemas.

Suas qualificações:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Farmácia ou Administração;
  • Experiência em Planejamento de Produção e/ou Materiais, com uso de sistemas de gestão integrada;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel;
  • Conhecimento desejável em Power BI;
  • Familiaridade com dados no SAP (PIR, BOM, MR, PV);
  • Inglês avançado; espanhol será considerado diferencial

Na Haleon, vamos além das expectativas e impulsionamos uma cultura em que fazemos o que mais importa. Promovemos um ambiente onde a diversidade seja celebrada, a equidade seja praticada e a inclusão seja vivenciada.

Nosso compromisso é humanizar as relações, respeitando a individualidade e garantindo que cada colaborador sinta-se valorizado, incluído e parte essencial de nossa comunidade.

AI Security Engineer (IAM)

A organização de Security & Resiliency gerencia os riscos de segurança em todos os aspectos dos negócios da Dell. Você terá uma excelente oportunidade de influenciar a cultura de segurança da Dell e desenvolver ainda mais sua carreira.

Junte-se a nós como AI Security Engineer (IAM) , em nossa equipe de Cybersecurity Engineering & Operations , no Brasil , para realizar o melhor trabalho da sua carreira e gerar um impacto social profundo.

O que você irá alcançar

Como AI Security Engineer (IAM) , você será membro da nossa organização interna de Cybersecurity , com a responsabilidade de contribuir com sua experiência e habilidades técnicas para o ambiente de infraestrutura de segurança da Dell.


Seu foco será a engenharia e a operação de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial para gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), o que inclui interagir e colaborar com stakeholders internos, clientes, parceiros e fornecedores.

Você irá:

  • Gerenciar processos e tecnologias para implementar operações do ciclo de vida de identidades para agentes de IA e service principals, incluindo criação, rotação, revogação e desativação, garantindo forte capacidade de auditoria.
  • Administrar políticas de RBAC e ABAC para fluxos de trabalho agentivos e aplicar guardrails em endpoints de modelos, repositórios de dados e integrações com ferramentas.
  • Gerenciar credenciais utilizados por agentes de IA, incluindo políticas de cofre (vault), cronogramas de rotação e detecção de uso indevido de credenciais.
  • Colaborar com equipes de produto para capturar casos de uso e traduzi-los em controles de IAM concretos para agentes, modelos e caminhos de acesso a dados.
  • Auxiliar em investigações e respostas a incidentes envolvendo IA agentiva, correlacionando logs de prompts, ações, chamadas de ferramentas e eventos de acesso a dados.

Dê o primeiro passo em direção à carreira dos seus sonhos


Todas as pessoas da nossa equipe agregam algo único. Veja o que estamos buscando para esta posição:

Requisitos Essenciais:

  • Inglês avançado para atuação em um time global
  • Conhecimento sólido de fluxos OAuth e OIDC e compreender controles de acesso baseados em grupos do AD/Entra, incluindo emissão de group claims em JWT/SAML com filtragem adequada. Conhecimento fundamental em IAM é essencial para esta função (autenticação, autorização e PAM). Desejável: conhecimentos básicos de scripting (Python/TypeScript) para automatizar integrações e revisões.
  • Experiência na implementação de controles e padrões de conformidade de IAM para agentes de IA, incluindo suporte a atividades de auditoria, e capacidade demonstrada de colaborar com Arquitetos de IAM para manter e evoluir continuamente configurações, runbooks e fluxos de acesso
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de agentes (LangGraph/LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen) e/ou plataformas de agentes (Lindy, Orq.ai)
  • Experiência trabalhando com plataformas de governança de IA e MLOps (por exemplo, DataRobot, Dataiku), oferecendo suporte a fluxos de aprovação, trilhas de auditoria e validações de conformidade. Fortes habilidades de colaboração multifuncional e capacidade de traduzir requisitos em arquiteturas seguras de IAM e de agentes, em parceria com times de aplicações, plataforma, segurança e dados.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Gestão de Sistemas de Informação, Cibersegurança, Segurança da Informação ou área relacionada; ou experiência equivalente.
  • Certificação em cybersecurity emitida por ISC², SANS ou entidade equivalente.

Quem somos

Acreditamos que cada pessoa tem o poder de gerar impacto. É por isso que colocamos as pessoas da nossa equipe no centro de tudo o que fazemos. Se você está procurando uma oportunidade de desenvolver a sua carreira em um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, com a tecnologia mais avançada do setor, estamos procurando por você.

title: Senior Procurement Manager
description:
Senior Procurement Manager

Department: Finance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Procurement Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is responsible for leading and owning the procurement function for the tournament, with a strong focus on strategic influence, stakeholder management, and governance in a complex, very dynamic, and highly scrutinized environment.

In addition to delivering the full scope of procurement activities, including all operational aspects, the role acts as a senior business partner to leadership and project owners, proactively shaping procurement approaches, interpreting and adapting FIFA procurement policies to local and operational realities where justified, and driving alignment across functions.

The role requires senior judgment, credibility, negotiation skills, and authority to manage competing interests, challenge non‑compliant behavior, and resolve escalated or sensitive procurement matters, while ensuring transparency, integrity, and value for money across all procurement activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing governance of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, exercising senior judgment to contextualise policy application to local operational realities if needed, while safeguarding principles of efficiency, integrity and competition.
  • Ensure procurement processes are fit‑for‑purpose, proportionate, and risk‑based, balancing governance with operational speed and effectiveness.
  • Act as the senior procurement authority for FIFA27, providing clear direction, guidance, and challenge to project leaders, senior stakeholders, and functional heads.
  • Proactively influence senior internal stakeholders to embed procurement best practices and ensure early engagement in procurement planning.
  • Lead, support and mentor the FIFA27 Procurement team.
  • Serve as the primary interface between FIFA27 and FIFA HQ, ensuring alignment while representing FIFA27’s specific operational needs.
  • Contribute to the set‑up, maturity, and continuous improvement of the procurement function for the tournament.
  • Responsible for the FIFA27 SAP cost contract database, including SAP contract data maintenance and Purchase Order creation, ensuring data integrity and audit readiness.
  • Produce procurement and spend analysis reports for management and senior leadership as required.
  • Train employees on an on‑going basis to ensure adherence to FIFA27 Procurement Policy.
  • Support project leaders in all matters regarding procurement including tasks such as RFI/RFP process, evaluating proposals, and negotiating contracts to ensure best terms and conditions.
  • Facilitate inter‑departmental alignment on key procurement projects

YOUR PROFILE

  • Terciary education in Business Administration, Procurement and/or extensive experience in indirect procurement.
  • 7-10 years’ experience in a similar role, including senior or lead roles.
  • Experience setting up or scaling procurement functions in project‑based or fast‑moving organisations.
  • Strong background in complex tendering processes, major procurement projects and contract management.
  • Experience in managing teams.
  • Very good SAP MM knowledge
  • Knowledge of DocuSign is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Monday.com is an asset.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow is an asset
  • Sound judgment and ability to balance governance, risk, and operational realities.
  • Strong senior‑level stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to engage and challenge at executive level.
  • Practical mindset and solution oriented.
  • Strong analytical skills, ability to handle complexity and conflicting interests.
  • Capable of working in an environment of rapid change, tight deadlines and high scrutiny.
  • Deep understanding of procurement governance, compliance and contractual frameworks
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Partner Rights Delivery Manager

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team in Zurich and Brazil and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Head of Commercial Partnerships, the Partner Rights Delivery Manager supports the operational implementation and fulfillment of FIFA Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations. This role includes coordination of official sites requirements, stadiums preparations, and the delivery of Commercial Partners activities and related deliverables.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the planning and execution of the operational implementation and delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Commercial Partners agreements.
  • Implement and coordinate all commercial operations in line with the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • Support the implementation of all commercial/sponsorship activations and commercial rights programmes of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Collaborate with the Stadium Venue Managers, Stadium Authorities, and relevant Functional Areas to ensure delivery of the contractual rights and obligations of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Assist in coordinating and delivering stadium inspections, open days, and Commercial Partner operational visits, ensuring alignment with commercial and F&B concessions requirements.
  • Manage and monitor the implementation of FIFA’s clean site obligation and Commercial Partners’ exclusivity in the official sites.
  • Ensure the Commercial Partners’ recognition programme is correctly implemented in designated stadium areas in accordance with established guidelines, including within the F&B concessions programme.
  • Assist in the implementation of specific commercial/marketing projects at the stadiums, such as Stadium Fan Experience areas, Special Marketing Programmes, Youth Programme, Value-in-Kind (VIK) operations, LED pitch side board operations, and other Commercial Partner activities, in coordination with the FIFA/FIFA27 project leads and the entire Partnership Rights Delivery team.
  • Act as an operational point of contact for Commercial Partners in the host country for commercial delivery matters, supporting issue resolution and expectation management throughout the event delivery process.
  • Work with PRD suppliers and assist them in the delivery of their obligations.
  • Support the planning and delivery of all Partnership Rights Delivery related spaces, facilities and flows in the stadiums (and other official sites) as per defined stadium requirements under the guidance of the FIFA PRD project lead.
  • Provide operational support to the Partnership Rights Delivery Venue Team (Marketing Venue Managers) during the tournament period.
  • Take primary responsibility for the administrative preparation and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive documentation, operational guidelines, briefing materials, tracking tools, and structured reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency across all Partnership Rights Delivery activities.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports, guidelines, and presentations on rights delivery progress, highlighting key achievements, risks, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to the preparation of tournament debrief documentation.
  • Assume administrative responsibility for the Partnership Rights Delivery team and provide support as required.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree, ideally in Sports Management, Sports Administration, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field, with exposure to commercial/marketing operations or sponsorship activations.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced, and project-driven environment, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial operations and/or sponsorship activations in major event settings and/or the sports industry.
  • Experience working in international sports events or large-scale event environments is considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Experience in the planning and delivery of fan experience areas and activations is considered an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • Very strong administrative skills, with proven ability to produce high-quality documentation, guidelines, reports, and structured tracking tools.
  • Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and a structured working approach.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate and deliver projects within an event environment, manage priorities effectively, and work independently within defined responsibilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Service-oriented mindset with a proactive and solution-driven approach to commercial rights delivery.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and perform effectively under tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, persistence, and resilience in dynamic environments.

Certification & Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams; knowledge of Visio and MS Project is an advantage).
  • Experience using planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours during peak project phases and tournament time.

Candidate Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the employment (pre-tournament and operational tournament time).

title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description:
About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times a year in person in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

Technology Focus

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology – from the kernel through userspace. Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical:

  • RustVMM – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability.
  • Rockcraft – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
  • LXD – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI.
  • Kubernetes (MicroK8s & Charmed Kubernetes) – building on‑rail K8s, Charmed Kubernetes, and operations tooling.
  • OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph) – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments.

These teams hire system‑level C/C++, Go, Rust and Python developers to work on security‑critical, performance‑critical and mission‑critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management.

Location

We have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.

What You Will Focus On

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach.
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise.
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth.
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product.
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team.
  • Write high‑quality code to create new features.
  • Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them.
  • Review code produced by other engineers.
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.

What We Are Looking For in You

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path.
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations.
  • Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology.
  • Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each.

Additional Skills We Value

  • Performance engineering and security experience.

What We Offer You

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Lead IT Engineer - Service Management
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at

About The Team

The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.

About The Role

As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.

You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.
  • Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.
  • Owning the end-to-end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems.
  • Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations.
  • Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first-contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders.
  • Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.
  • Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential in a regulated financial environment.
  • Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.
  • Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.
  • Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end-to-end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.
  • Ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced, engineering‑led environment, with strong influence‑without‑authority skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership.

Nice‑to‑have Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, high‑growth tech, or other regulated industries.
  • Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles.
  • Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams.
  • Fluent English.

What We Offer

  • Greenfield, high‑visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering.
  • A culture that values ownership and getting foundations right, without bureaucracy for its own sake.

Our Benefits – Brazil

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/Meal Card (Vale‑Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program
  • Life Insurance
  • Medical Plan
  • Dental Plan
  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program
  • Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses
  • Extended Parental Leave
  • Daycare Allowance
  • Parental Consultancy
  • Work‑from‑home Allowance
  • Gym Partnerships
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

(For hybrid roles, commuting‑related benefits such as Vale‑Transport and gym partnerships remain applicable.)

Work Model for This Role

Hybrid – 2–3 times per week in the office.

Explore How We Build Technology At Nubank

  • building.nubank.com.br
  • youtube.com/@building.nubank
  • Our stories on Spotify

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nubank, we want to be sure that we’re building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That’s why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company, while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

How to Apply

If you’re excited about building a robust IT Service Management foundation that enables Nubank to scale with reliability and speed, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and help us shape the future of financial services in Latin America.

title: Python Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a general track role, hiring for every team at Canonical who works in Python, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you believe you are already an outstanding Python engineer.

Canonical works across the entire open source spectrum. Canonical Ubuntu is well‑known as a developer favourite and enterprise‑friendly Linux. Our web services and system utilities are often written in Python, which we choose where collaboration with other teams, ecosystems and communities is more important than raw performance.

We hire Python Developers with a passion for open‑source software, innovation, and cutting‑edge technologies. We also look for colleagues who understand that a great product is more than code – it is ready for the unexpected, it is well documented, it is comprehensively tested, it is tastefully presented in its CLI or GUI. At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions through high‑quality, idiomatic Python code.

Your team will own a product that may comprise several codebases. These may be intended to run on servers, or on Kubernetes, or on the desktop, or as web services for Ubuntu clients. They may be utilities or frameworks or tools, or part of our production process.

Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open‑source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale.

Location: we have remote Python engineering roles in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Write high‑quality, well‑designed and well‑tested Python software
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Display technical leadership at Canonical and in our communities
  • Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them
  • Contribute to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind
  • Work from home with global travel twice a year for company events

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above‑and‑beyond expectations
  • Well‑organised, self‑starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience writing thoroughly designed, modern, maintainable Python
  • Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross‑compilation
  • Additional languages, particularly Golang or Rust, C or C++
  • Deep quality and test engineering
  • Web or Flutter front‑end experience
  • REST and gRPC API experience
  • SQL and NoSQL data store expertise
  • Experience with public clouds or OpenStack
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu packaging
  • Experience with systems programming or scalable web services
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Manager, Brand
description:
Senior Manager, Brand


Department: Communications


Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time


Location: Brazil


Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (\"FWWC2027\") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION


The Senior Brand Manager at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement and localize brand plans in line with the Tournament Brand Strategy strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



  • Act as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Tournament matters.

  • Drive and support the strategic and project management of brand localization and implementation.

  • Partners closely with internal stakeholders, and local organising partners to create distinctive brand platforms that are insight-driven, future-focused, and aligned with FIFA’s overarching identity system.

  • Leads on the ground the tournament brand implementation plan in close collaboration with tournament project teams and local organizing/hosting stakeholders.

  • Respective of process and timelines, from brief to execution.

  • Respective over communication within the Brand and Marketing department and outside _ for all Brand Tournament related matters.

  • Develops locally relevant promotional material inline with Brand central guidance.

  • Leads the implementation on the ground of event dressing

  • Safeguards and evolves FIFA’s brand equity across internal and external partners, ensuring strategic alignment, creative integrity, and cross-functional execution excellence throughout the brand lifecycle.

  • Manages the delivery of brand tournament related assets (including marks, look & feel, mascots, trophies …), printed/digital materials, and brand manuals to the highest standards of quality and consistency.

  • Important : Partners with the internal creative studio and external agencies to develop the assets.


YOUR PROFILE


Education & Qualifications

  • University degree, Masters or equivalent in Marketing or Business

  • Experience in a global brand marketing function, preferred Sports Events or Entertainment

  • Proven experience leading brand development and strategic planning process

  • Demonstrated experience in leading go-to-market /360 launch plans

  • Football experience a strong plus


Competencies and personality

  • Mandatory previous experience in similar Brand role. Strong understanding of Brand Management framework and KPIs.

  • Strong understanding of sports events.

  • Strong understanding of design

  • Business driven with strong analytical skills

  • Goal oriented and result-driven, strong decision making skills

  • Has a sense of creativity and aesthetic sensitivity

  • Well-structured and great organizational skills

  • Ability to manage multiple projects in cross-functional collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal skills, able to present strategy and concept to partners and management

  • Entrepreneurial spirt with innovative mind-set

  • Flexibility

  • Self-Motivation

  • Empathy

  • Negotiating skills

  • Teamwork abilities


Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English

  • Right to work in Brazil

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Procurement Manager
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Procurement Manager for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 is responsible for leading and owning the procurement function for the tournament, with a strong focus on strategic influence, stakeholder management, and governance in a complex, very dynamic, and highly scrutinized environment. In addition to delivering the full scope of procurement activities, including all operational aspects of it, the role acts as a senior business partner to leadership and project owners, proactively shaping procurement approaches, interpreting and adapting FIFA procurement policies to local and operational realities where justified, and driving alignment across functions. The role requires senior judgment, credibility, negotiation skills, and authority to manage competing interests, challenge non‑compliant behavior, and resolve escalated or sensitive procurement matters, while ensuring transparency, integrity, and value for money across all procurement activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing governance of the FIFA27 Procurement Policy, exercising senior judgment to contextualise policy application to local operational realities if needed, while safeguarding principles of efficiency, integrity and competition.
  • Ensure procurement processes are fit‑for‑purpose, proportionate, and risk‑based, balancing governance with operational speed and effectiveness.
  • Act as the senior procurement authority for FIFA27, providing clear direction, guidance, and challenge to project leaders, senior stakeholders, and functional heads.
  • Proactively influence senior internal stakeholders to embed procurement best practices and ensure early engagement in procurement planning.
  • Lead, support and mentor the FIFA27 Procurement team.
  • Serve as the primary interface between FIFA27 and FIFA HQ, ensuring alignment while representing FIFA27’s specific operational needs.
  • Contribute to the set‑up, maturity, and continuous improvement of the procurement function for the tournament.
  • Responsible for the FIFA27 SAP cost contract database, including SAP contract data maintenance and Purchase Order creation, ensuring data integrity and audit readiness.
  • Produce procurement and spend analysis reports for management and senior leadership as required.
  • Train employees on an on-going basis to ensure adherence to FIFA27 Procurement Policy.
  • Support project leaders in all matters regarding procurement including tasks such as RFI/RFP process, evaluating proposals, and negotiating contracts to ensure best terms and conditions.
  • Facilitate inter‑departmental alignment on key procurement projects.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Terciary education in Business Administration, Procurement and/or extensive experience in indirect procurement.
  • 7-10 years’ experience in a similar role, including senior or lead roles.
  • Experience setting up or scaling procurement functions in project‑based or fast‑moving organisations.
  • Strong background in complex tendering processes, major procurement projects and contract management.
  • Experience in managing teams.
  • Very good SAP MM knowledge.
  • Knowledge of DocuSign is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Monday.com is an asset.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow is an asset.
  • Sound judgment and ability to balance governance, risk, and operational realities.
  • Strong senior‑level stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to engage and challenge at executive level.
  • Practical mindset and solution oriented.
  • Strong analytical skills, ability to handle complexity and conflicting interests.
  • Capable of working in an environment of rapid change, tight deadlines and high scrutiny.
  • Deep understanding of procurement governance, compliance and contractual frameworks.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Junior Graphic Designer
description:
Junior Graphic Designer

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Junior Graphic designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments.

You will support the creative development of Brand assets, ensuring consistent, world-class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives.

This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Purpose of the Role: This role combines world class graphic design excellence, strong project management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in the realm of sports and entertainment. This role reports to the Global head of Brand, marketing & promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines. Experience in Graphic Design in brand development context is mandatory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Supports creative process from concept to execution across channels ensuring high-quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Designs & produces creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develop key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital-first creative assets.
  • Ensure strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards, while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic Design experience in the context of Brand creation and brand assets and collaterals.
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High-level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands‑on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Skills

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.
  • Experienced in managing multiple concurrent projects under tight timelines, with consistent attention to detail and creative quality.
  • Familiar with rights management, usage permissions, and protection of brand and design IP.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven HANDS‑ON expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working with large-scale brand projects, live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Proficient in Word / PowerPoint / Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in graphic design roles within agency, entertainment, FMCG, or sports-related industries.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.
