A missão desse cargo é efetuar com segurança as rotinas de enfermagem, a organização e registros utilizados na assistência aos pacientes do Hospital.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar as rotinas de enfermagem da Instituição (passagem de plantão, registro de intercorrências, notificações de eventos, etc.);
  • Manter o posto de Enfermagem organizado para as atividades laborativas;
  • Receber, conferir, administrar e devolver as medicações prescritas;
  • Executar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem – Prescrição de Enfermagem e Plano de Cuidados;
  • Realizar os registros seguros da sua prática profissional;
  • Realizar curativo simples e comunicar ao enfermeiro;
  • Preparar o paciente para exames e tratamentos internos e externos, se houver necessidade;
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, sempre comunicando ao Enfermeiro.
  • Executar tratamentos especificamente prescritos, ou de rotina, além de outras atividades de enfermagem;
  • Ministrar medicamentos por via oral, IM e uso tópico relatando quaisquer alterações e/ou intercorrências ao Enfermeiro responsável;
  • Administrar nebulização, enema e calor ou frio conforme prescrição;
  • Realizar o controle de pacientes e contactantes de doenças transmissíveis, sob a supervisão do Enfermeiro;
  • Colher material (Urina e Fezes) para exames laboratoriais por método convencional;
  • Prestar cuidados de enfermagem pré e pós-procedimentos;
  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;
  • Verificar e registrar sinais vitais para monitorar o estado de saúde dos pacientes, como temperatura, pressão arterial, pulso, respiração e glicemia capilar;
  • Realizar registros precisos das informações dos pacientes, incluindo sinais vitais, medicamentos administrados, procedimentos realizados e observações relevantes sobre o estado do paciente;
  • Realizar rondas conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);
  • Auxiliar e incentivar a realização das atividades de vida diárias, tais como higiene pessoal, alimentação, mobilidade e eliminação.
  • Auxiliar no posicionamento dos pacientes confortavelmente na cama e movê-los com segurança quando necessário;
  • Realizar mudança de decúbito em paciente acamado;
  • Auxiliar e incentivar na organização dos pertences e quarto dos pacientes;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem dos materiais, de equipamentos e de dependências de unidades de saúde;
  • Integrar a equipe de Saúde reportando todos os dados para o enfermeiro responsável pelo setor;
  • Realizar apoio e interação com toda equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Realizar observação contínua aos pacientes e relatar quaisquer alterações aos enfermeiros responsáveis.
  • Participar de atividades em saúde, seguindo prescrição de enfermagem e médica;
  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro na execução dos programas de Educação para a Saúde;
  • Executar trabalhos de rotina vinculados à alta de pacientes;
  • Participar de procedimentos pós morte;
  • Realizar a coleta venosa e de secreção oro e nasofaringe. Preparo e realização do teste Toxicológico, Covid 19, entre outros testes não invasivos.
  • Entre outras rotinas pertinentes ao cargo.

  • Vivência na função em Hospital, preferência voltado para saúde mental;
  • Dinamismo, bom relacionamento interpessoal.

title: Analista de Marketing Pleno - Responsabilidade Social
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responsável por apoiar a gestão das iniciativas de Investimento Social Privado (ISP), contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos, campanhas sociais e articulação com áreas internas e parceiros.
  • Acompanhamento e gestão de projetos educacionais e interesse da comunidade, com monitoramento de ações e metas.
  • Gestão de projetos incentivados por Leis de Incentivo Federais e Municipais, com interface com a área de Planejamento Tributário para alinhamento estratégico.
  • Elaboração e acompanhamento de contratos e pagamentos relacionados às iniciativas de ESG.
  • Elaboração de relatórios e apresentações para diretoria e áreas estratégicas.
  • Apoio no planejamento e execução de Campanhas Sociais (Empodera Ela, Abril Azul e Dia da Árvore).
  • Suporte na implementação e acompanhamento das iniciativas da área de Sustentabilidade da ALLOS.
  • Relacionamento com stakeholders internos (shoppings e holding) e externos (Instituições e Fornecedores).

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Comunicação Social, Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Formação complementar em ESG - Sustentabilidade.
  • Experiência anterior com projetos sociais.

O Que Temos Para Você

A missão desse cargo será auxiliar na prestação de cuidados aos pacientes em um ambiente hospitalar. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a assistência direta aos pacientes, a realização de procedimentos técnicos e a colaboração com a equipe de saúde.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Manter o posto de Enfermagem organizado para as atividades laborativas;
  • Receber, conferir, administrar e devolver as medicações prescritas;

  • Realizar os registros seguros da sua prática profissional;
  • Realizar curativo simples e comunicar ao enfermeiro;
  • Preparar o paciente para exames e tratamentos internos e externos, se houver necessidade;
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, sempre comunicando ao Enfermeiro.

  • Colher material (Urina e Fezes) para exames laboratoriais por método convencional;
  • Prestar cuidados de enfermagem pré e pós-procedimentos;
  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;
  • Verificar e registrar sinais vitais para monitorar o estado de saúde dos pacientes, como temperatura, pressão arterial, pulso, respiração e glicemia capilar;
  • Realizar registros precisos das informações dos pacientes, incluindo sinais vitais, medicamentos administrados, procedimentos realizados e observações relevantes sobre o estado do paciente;
  • Apoiar na realização da contenção mecânica;
  • Realizar rondas conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Realizar manejo e abordagem aos pacientes com instabilidade psíquica;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);
  • Auxiliar e incentivar a realização das atividades de vida diárias, tais como higiene pessoal, alimentação, mobilidade e eliminação.
  • Auxiliar no posicionamento dos pacientes confortavelmente na cama e movê-los com segurança quando necessário;
  • Realizar mudança de decúbito em paciente acamado;
  • Atuar sob supervisão do enfermeiro em intercorrências clínicas e psíquicas;
  • Auxiliar e incentivar na organização dos pertences e quarto dos pacientes;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem dos materiais, de equipamentos e de dependências de unidades de saúde;
  • Oferecer apoio emocional aos pacientes, ouvindo suas preocupações e fornecendo conforto sempre que necessário. Buscando sempre um profissional da Equipe multidisciplinar e Enfermeiro em situações de saúde emocionalmente desafiadora;
  • Integrar a equipe de Saúde reportando todos os dados para o enfermeiro responsável pelo setor;
  • Realizar apoio e interação com toda equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Realizar observação contínua aos pacientes e relatar quaisquer alterações aos enfermeiros responsáveis.
  • Participar de atividades em saúde, seguindo prescrição de enfermagem e médica;
  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro na execução dos programas de Educação para a Saúde;
  • Executar trabalhos de rotina vinculados à alta de pacientes;
  • Participar de procedimentos pós-morte;
  • Realizar a coleta venosa e de secreção oro e nasofaringe. Preparo e realização do teste Toxicológico, Covid 19, entre outros testes não invasivos.
  • Entre outras rotinas pertinentes ao cargo.

title: Software Engineering Director
description:
Overview

This is the general track for Engineering Director at Canonical, apply here if you are confident to run a project which spans teams and time zones, hiring and managing engineering managers and staff engineers.

Canonical's largest software products are built by multiple teams working together under a single director of engineering. Once you have passed the first round of interviews we will discuss specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.

We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering directors set the pace and the direction to help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.

Responsibilities

Even though this is a senior management position, managing managers, we expect Engineering Directors to be outstanding developers with the confidence to lead by example across the full range of activities in their teams. You need to understand what great code looks like in the language and genre of your product - whether that is a web service, or a system daemon, or a desktop application, or a distributed system. You\'ll need to know how to drive testing and benchmarking to improve the clarity in your teams around quality and performance. You\'ll also need to be confident to set and defend high expectations of work ethic, consistency, focus and learning.

  • Lead multiple teams of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Develop your engineering managers and maintain Canonical culture
  • Hire staff level engineers for specific roles like performance and quality
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure indicators of team health and productivity
  • Ensure rounded delivery including community participation and docs
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes and defend them
  • Set and measure progress against benchmark goals for speed and efficiency
  • Represent your product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
  • Collaborate with leads for related or dependent products

What we're looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Extensive management experience and confidence to set high expectations
  • Outstanding Linux based software engineering track record
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Public speaking and presentation skills
  • A love of developing and growing people and a track record of it
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring software developers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • You have advanced expertise in your own domain
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • You have a demonstrated drive for continual learning
  • Builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills We Value

  • Experience in a developer advocacy or community role
  • Open source community engagement and leadership
  • Ops and system administration experience
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
Na Amaris Consulting , acreditamos que a tecnologia deve servir às pessoas — e não o contrário. Somos uma consultoria independente de tecnologia e gestão que apoia empresas em seus projetos de transformação em todo o mundo.

Presente em mais de 60 países e reunindo mais de 7.000 pessoas de 110 nacionalidades diferentes, atuamos em diversos setores — desde tecnologia da informação, engenharia, ciências da vida, até energia e telecomunicações.

Nosso objetivo é construir um futuro mais inteligente e sustentável, impulsionando a inovação e o crescimento de nossos clientes e de nossos talentos.

Descrição do cargo

Sua missão será criar, desenvolver e tornar rentável e sustentável a sua própria Unidade de Negócio , tendo controle operacional e estratégico sobre ela.

Para garantir o crescimento dessa estrutura, você atuará diariamente em cinco eixos principais:

Suas missões

Negócios e Estratégia

  • Gerir, coordenar e desenvolver uma Unidade de Negócio, assegurando seu crescimento.
  • Realizar um mapeamento de clientes/ofertas, tecnologias e competências do mercado com o apoio de outros departamentos internos do Grupo.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais técnicas e financeiras estruturadas e negociar preços.
  • Preparar e conduzir reuniões de qualificação entre clientes e consultores.
  • Realizar revisões de projeto, acompanhamento e relatórios de desempenho.
  • Monitorar as atividades dos clientes para antecipar e conquistar novos projetos.
  • Manter o portfólio de clientes atualizado e fortalecer parcerias existentes.
  • Abrir novas contas, gerenciando aspectos legais e contratuais.

Gestão Financeira

  • Analisar e otimizar o Profit & Loss (P&L), calculando margens.
  • Realizar análises avançadas de rentabilidade, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e elaborar planos de ação para otimizar faturamento e margem contributiva.
  • Gerenciar temas relacionados à recuperação de créditos.

Gestão de Equipe

  • Contribuir na elaboração e análise de planos de negócios.
  • Acompanhar e apoiar o desenvolvimento das pessoas-chave da equipe.
  • Propor e implementar novos processos e iniciativas de melhoria.
  • Participar do recrutamento e da gestão da equipe de consultores (prospecção, entrevistas, relatórios, assinatura de contratos etc.).
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de carreira da equipe (atribuição de funções, avaliações, envolvimento de talentos-chave etc.).
  • Antecipar e gerenciar situações de intercontrato, propondo soluções adequadas.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, com histórico de cumprimento ou superação de metas.
  • Experiência com mercado de tecnologia.
  • Forte entendimento das técnicas de vendas e do ambiente corporativo B2B.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação.
  • Fluência em português e inglês.
  • Formação superior completa.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

O que oferecemos

  • Um ambiente internacional com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • A possibilidade de atuar diretamente com clientes de diferentes países (Estados Unidos e Europa).
  • Presença em São Paulo, Curitiba e Rio de Janeiro , com oportunidades de realocação entre projetos .
  • Um modelo de negócio sólido e sustentável, com crescimento anual de 52% e mais de 400 projetos ativos no Brasil .
  • Uma cultura que valoriza o acompanhamento individual, o desenvolvimento de competências e a formação contínua .
  • Uma abordagem centrada nas pessoas — sem bodyshopping , com foco em carreira e evolução profissional .

Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Plano de Previdência Privada;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • Welhub;

A história da Bauducco® começou há quase 70 anos, com Carlo Bauducco trazendo ao Brasil uma receita de família e um sonho empreendedor. De lá para cá, mantivemos viva essa essência, combinando tradição, qualidade e inovação.

Com seis fábricas, 12 filiais, sete CDs e mais de 6 mil colaboradores, levamos nossos produtos a mais de 180 mil pontos de venda no Brasil e exportamos para mais de 50 países.

Desde 2001, fazemos parte do Grupo Pandurata, que também inclui as marcas Visconti®, Tommy® e a Ellece Logística.

Sobre a Vaga

O design é o coração do nosso negócio — e o(a) Designer de Produção Pleno é peça-chave para garantir que o que foi criado vire produto com qualidade, fidelidade e viabilidade técnica.

Qualificações e Competências

  • Vivência prática com processos gráficos/produtivos e fechamento de arquivo.

  • Capacidade de estruturar arquivos "à prova de erro": camadas, nomes, padrões, versões e documentação simples.

Edição de Fotos, Vídeos e Motion Design

  • Capturar, editar e finalizar fotos e vídeos institucionais.
  • Produzir animações, vinhetas e elementos gráficos utilizando técnicas de motion design.

  • Definir, adaptar e manter atualizado o layout de todos os materiais institucionais da companhia, como apresentações executivas, roteiros, folders e conteúdos corporativos.
  • Criar e adaptar conceitos visuais e desdobrar peças para campanhas de comunicação internas e externas, on e offline, considerando diferentes públicos e contextos.
  • Garantir coerência entre identidade visual, mensagem e estratégia institucional.
  • Experiência na finalização de materiais e projetos junto a parceiros, como gráficas, agências de publicidade e comunicação, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e conformidade ao guia da marca.
  • Criar peças visuais de apoio para eventos, feiras e apresentações institucionais.
  • Adequar identidades visuais para diferentes formatos e demandas.

Descrição da vaga

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive uma transformação contínua, impulsionada pela evolução tecnológica, novos comportamentos de consumo e a diversificação de plataformas e modelos de monetização. Nesse cenário, múltiplos players competem pela atenção do usuário e pelos investimentos dos anunciantes, exigindo constante inovação em produtos, distribuição e modelos de negócio. A Globo vem evoluindo sua atuação para capturar essas oportunidades, explorando novos formatos, experiências e estratégias. Para isso, é essencial compreender os movimentos da indústria e tendências tecnológicas, evoluir capacidades digitais e arquiteturas de suporte, identificar gaps e alavancas estratégicas, e fomentar inovação e parcerias. A arquitetura de tecnologia é um elemento central para viabilizar essa transformação.

Atuação de Arquitetura: A área de Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo atua na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e execução. Sua missão é desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diferentes domínios de negócio e foundations da empresa. A atuação combina visão estratégica, direcionamento tático e forte colaboração com produto, engenharia e áreas de negócio.

Resumo da Estrutura

  • Arquitetura Corporativa
  • Arquitetura de Soluções
  • Arquitetura de Dados & IA

O que você vai encontrar aqui

  • Atuação em iniciativas de alta relevância e impacto estratégico
  • Exposição ao ecossistema de mídia, produtos digitais e monetização
  • Desenvolvimento de visão transversal entre negócio e tecnologia
  • Especialização em um domínio crítico para a evolução digital da Globo

Arquitetura de Soluções

Essa posição tem papel fundamental na evolução da arquitetura de soluções do domínio de Produtos Digitais, com atuação integrada junto à Arquitetura Corporativa, times de engenharia e Tech Leads, e times de produto. O foco é garantir alinhamento entre estratégia tecnológica e implementação das soluções, atuando próxima aos times de delivery.

Modelo de Trabalho

Híbrido - São Paulo/SP ou Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Evoluir a arquitetura de soluções e integrações do domínio de Produtos Digitais

  • Elaborar e manter diagramas arquiteturais (blocos, camadas e integrações)
  • Garantir alinhamento entre estratégia tecnológica e execução dos times de produto e plataforma
  • Definir e orientar o fluxo de informações entre sistemas e domínios
  • Apoiar decisões arquiteturais (ex: padrões, integrações, buy vs build)

  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em escala, performance e eficiência das soluções

  • Inglês intermediário/avançado

  • Conhecimento em APIs (REST / GraphQL) e arquitetura de microserviços
  • Familiaridade com linguagens como JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js ou backend (Python, Java, Go, etc.)

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Workday Release and Adoption Manager is responsible for managing the technical and organizational aspects of Workday releases, driving user adoption, and supporting continuous improvement of Workday functionality across the organization. This role serves as the central point of coordination for release management, change communication, training and support, regression testing, and operational governance. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, deep Workday expertise, and a passion for driving organizational excellence through effective systems management and user enablement.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday release management and feature adoption. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional area requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Workday Community and Functional Area Self‑Service Support – Support organizational capability building and issue resolution
    • Manage Community user access and profiles
      • Work with HR and ETS to deactivate users no longer employed with the organization
      • Connect users to appropriate Community resources and documentation
    • Support submission of ideas to Ideation Hub to encourage Workday product development and new functionality
    • Support cross‑functional teams in continuous improvement efforts
    • Identify problems from recurrent issues and lead resolution efforts by coordinating resources
    • Oversee and manage escalated issue resolution
      • Manage Workday Support Cases and Ask‑an‑Expert tickets
      • Escalate issues as needed to ensure resolution
      • Ensure functional area operational continuity
  • Manage incidents and service requests
    • Report on and elevate tickets across all systems (Workday Help Cases, Request Framework, Security Requests, ServiceNow, other tools)
    • Ensure timely tracking and resolution
    • Generate and manage updates to Workday Help Articles for accuracy and relevance
  • Tenant Management – Manage non‑production Workday environments
    • Manage refresh schedules, refresh requests, and coordinate tenant refreshes for non‑production tenants
    • Maintain activity logs for each tenant
    • Communicate tenant refresh schedules and impacts to stakeholders
  • Releases and Regression Testing – Lead Workday release management and testing coordination
    • Log and disseminate all relevant weekly release notes and manage bi‑annual releases utilizing tools in Community, Adoption Planning, and Kainos SmartTest
    • Work with functional areas to ensure awareness of release information, including:
      • Release item notes and documentation
      • Testing coordination (responsibilities, timeframes, tenant refreshes)
      • Workday Support Case resolution and completion tracking
    • Support functional area learning of new functionality by connecting them with Workday Community resources
    • Support functional areas in regression and configuration testing of new functionality being implemented
      • Test planning, scenario development, and execution
      • Issue log management and resolution tracking
      • Completion verification and sign‑off
      • Research and champion new and emerging Workday functionality
      • Perform basic report writing and collaborate with report writers to identify exceptions and testing requirements
    • Operational Meetings and Support – Maintain operational governance and cross‑functional coordination
      • Build and maintain strong relationships with all functional area stakeholders
      • Meet regularly with operational areas to address issues and concerns
      • Prepare meeting agendas, materials, and action item tracking
      • Disseminate release updates and technical information that may impact operations
      • Support feature adoption
        • Assist with planning, scheduling, and coordination
        • Support status tracking and reporting
        • Coordinate cross‑functional engagement to manage feature impacts
        • Monitor effective and timely delivery
        • Identify and escape risks and issues
    • Change Log Management – Maintain comprehensive records of Workday changes
      • Document configuration changes and enhancements
      • Maintain change logs with implementation dates and responsible parties
      • Track configuration versions across all tenants
      • Communicate change history to stakeholders and functional area leads
      • Support audit and compliance reporting on system changes
    • Training and Support – Facilitate user enablement and continuous learning
      • Provide references to Workday Community Resources, such as user guides, quick reference materials, and training videos, for new and enhanced functionality
      • Manage Adoption Planning in Workday and collaborate with business units on release and feature adoption

    Core Competencies

    • Excellent communication skills and ability to build and maintain strong relationships; ability to convey complex technical information to non‑technical audiences
    • Possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail and ability to document
    • Passion for continuous improvement and proactive problem‑solving and ability to manage complex change processes
    • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, accurately collect information, assess situations, and then translate them into technical requirements
    • Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution
    • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in identifying helpful solutions and driving cross‑functional alignment
    • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
    • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data

    Minimum Requirements

    • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
    • Minimum 3 years of professional Workday experience with demonstrated expertise in system administration and best practices
    • Experience managing multiple bi‑annual or more frequent release cycles
    • Experience with change management and organizational adoption strategies
    • Proven ability to adhere to and promote Workday best practice methodologies across the organization
    • Basic report writing capabilities in Workday; ability to develop and modify standard reports
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Office productivity suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
    • Strong knowledge of Workday release and tenant management processes
    • Deep familiarity with Workday Community resources, including Workday Success Plans and self‑service materials
    • Knowledge of Workday Help – Cases and Articles functionality
    • Familiarity with ITSM tools and ticketing systems (ServiceNow or similar)

Descrição da vaga

Traga a sua energia para aLight !

title: Software Engineer - Cloud Images
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to work on Linux, cloud infrastructure, pipelines and automation, and open source software.

You will work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to make Ubuntu the best platform there is in the clouds. Your time will be split between build system development (using Python, Jenkins and shell), implementation of cloud-related features within Ubuntu Server itself, operation of our continuous delivery pipelines, and direct partner engagement. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers, and integrate our products with cloud native services.

What the role entails

  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Design, build and integrate new features and enhancements into Ubuntu that will support users of Ubuntu in public clouds
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Design and architect complex new systems and integrations with the clouds
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers and participate in design discussions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have practical experience with public clouds
  • You have interest and experience with at least 3 of the following: containers (docker, kubernetes, etc.), devops automation, open source projects, APIs, Linux systems administration, Python packaging, cloud-based applications
  • at least experience in Python software development on Linux

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast‑paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area‑related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross‑functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Expected Salary Range

$110,000 - $125,000

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releasees and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge base articles
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross-functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow-up and resolution
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment
  • Strong problem solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience

Expected Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

This position is responsible for the operation of machinery that performs machining in metallic structures. Planning, turning, drilling, and grinding are examples of machinery processes that are part of the work scope under the Machinery Technician responsibility.

  • Works on machinery workshop handling all machining process to support aircraft maintenance heavy check
  • Fabrication, grinding and repair of metal structures is part of the regular job accountabilities
  • Operate lathe machine and measure work pieces verifying dimensions using appropriate tools
  • Be familiar with boring, drilling, reaming, threading, and tapping operations
  • Detecting malfunctions, replacing worn tools, cleaning debris from machine
  • Report any faulty operation of equipment or defective materials to the area supervisor
  • Operate lifting devices for movement of materials and other equipment as needed
  • Be familiar with the preparation of tools for machining
  • Load feed mechanism by lifting stock into position
  • Maintain specifications by observing drilling, grooving, and cutting, including turning, facing, and threading
  • Responsible for keeping equipment and work area clean and orderly
  • Verify settings by measuring positions, first-run parts, and sample work pieces
  • Professionalism, integrity and work ethic while possessing a visionary skill set that will successfully carry the team into the future.
  • Must comply with Brazilian Norm NR -12 training and certification

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High school diploma or equivalent in Machining Operation technical course with emphasis in planning, turning, drilling, and grinding
  • Local driver’s license
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship
  • Previous NR-1
  • 3 years’ experience in aeronautical industry
  • Must have extensive knowledge of machinery operation with emphasis on the aeronautical industry
  • Must have experience operating lathe machine, milling machine, vertical and horizontal band saw, drill and tread machine, hydraulic press and oven operation for heat treatment
  • Mechanical problem-solving ability and troubleshooting skills a must
  • Must be able to read a tape measure, verify dimensions, use a straightedge and other measuring devices
  • Have the knowledge of machine drawings, fit and tolerances
  • Must be able to operate lifting devices
  • Must be able to read and understand work instructions, drawings, technical manuals and standards in English.
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

description:
Engenheiro de Poços - Híbrido - Rio de Janeiro - RJ

Brazil - Rio de Janeiro

  • 3 anos de experiência na área de planejamento e/ou acompanhamento da construção, abandono ou workover de poços de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento em softwares de simulação para análise de risco tais como : Well Cost Deterministic Pkg e Well Cost Advanced Pkg ou Genesis PFU (Completions Planning and Follow-up), Genesis Drilling e Genesis IVAC.
  • Na parte de Dados : Tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística e árvore de decisão.
  • Pacote Office : Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa.
  • Nível de Formação: Superior em Engenharia, devidamente registrados no Conselho Regional da área.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Gestão de Bancos de Dados : Criação, manutenção, atualização e migração de bancos de dados utilizados como base de conhecimento.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento de Campo : Análise contínua dos dados de intervenções de poços para organização e disponibilização estruturada das informações, desenvolvimento de análises para identificar correlações entre dados relevantes para planejamento e avaliação de riscos e avaliação de anormalidades nas intervenções, visando identificar tendências relacionadas à fase executada, à formação perfurada e às condições operacionais.
  • Análise técnica da informação preenchida no ou outro sistema adotado : Análise das intervenções, comunicação de divergências e garantia de convergência das informações e solicitação para implementação de alterações no banco de dados.
  • Controle de Qualidade das Bases de Dados dos Boletins de Intervenções em Poços: Utilização de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial e Business Intelligence para validação de dados, registro e manutenção da estruturação, taxonomia e ontologia dos dados e proposição de ajustes nos padrões e manuais.
  • Base Estatística dos Tempos das Operações: Criação e manutenção da base de dados históricos para análise da duração das operações, diferenciando tempos úteis e perdidos para composição de distribuições probabilísticas.
  • Apoio ao Planejamento de Intervenções: Organização e validação de informações para planejamento de intervenções futuras, análise de insumos, verificação da completude e validação das datas de início fim do estudo, simulação de duração das operações utilizando software específico e elaboração de relatórios conforme padrões estabelecidos e validados.
  • Análise Semestral e Plurianual de Controle de Processo : Avaliação da evolução temporal das operações e identificação de tendências para aprimoramento do processo.
  • Análise Específica: Estudo detalhado das características, tempos e anomalias das operações para identificação de padrões, correlações e tendências para um determinado período, campo ou bacia, podendo envolver dados internos ou externos.
  • Acompanhamento de Campanhas: Monitoramento do progresso das campanhas, atualização de projeções e análise de desvios em relação ao planejamento.
  • Desempenho de Operações Submarinas : Medidas de duração das operações submarinas segmentadas conforme a ontologia estabelecida e comparativo de desempenho entre prestadores de serviços, incluindo análises gráficas (boxplots).
  • Planejamento de Campanhas : Uso da base de conhecimento operacional para estimativas de duração, planejamento e análise técnico-econômica das campanhas.

Atividades Complementares:

  • Análise, suporte, revisão e elaboração de documentos técnicos;
  • Levantamento, tratamento e consolidação de dados;
  • Estudos comparativos de estimativas de duração;
  • Suporte técnico em governança de grupos temáticos e revisão de procedimentos técnicos;
  • Planejamento e acompanhamento de ações de pesquisa e desenvolvimento;
  • Avaliação de viabilidade técnica e econômica de tecnologias;
  • Atualização de configurações de poços em bases de dados;
  • Solicitação de orçamentação para estimativas de duração, quando necessário;
  • Alimentação de bases de dados externas com informações obtidas nas bases de dados;
  • Solicitação de acesso aos aplicativos e sistemas utilizados para execução dos serviços contratados.

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

  • Gestão do Conhecimento de Campo : Análise contínua dos dados de intervenções de poços para organização e disponibilização estruturada das informações, desenvolvimento de análises para identificar correlações entre dados relevantes para planejamento e avaliação de riscos e avaliação de anormalidades nas intervenções, visando identificar tendências relacionadas à fase executada, à formação perfurada e às condições operacionais.

  • Desempenho de Operações Submarinas : Medidas de duração das operações submarinas segmentadas conforme a ontologia estabelecida e comparativo de desempenho entre prestadores de serviços, incluindo análises gráficas (boxplots).

Position Title

Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor of Social Work

Appointment Type

Full-Time, Tenure-Track

Department

Social Work

Reports To

Dean, School of Social Work

Position Summary

The School of Social Work seeks candidates for two open-rank faculty positions (Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor), with rank determined based on qualifications and experience. Successful candidates will be responsible for teaching, research and scholarship, and service consistent with the mission of the institution and the accreditation standards of the Council on Social Work Education. The position emphasizes high-quality teaching, the development and/or maintenance of a sustainable research agenda, and meaningful contributions to service within the school, university, profession, and community.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Teaching and Instruction

  • Teach graduate social work courses to include use of appropriate technologies
  • Use inclusive, student-centered instructional strategies
  • Participate in curriculum development and assessment
  • Mentor MSW and PhD students

Research and Scholarship

  • Develop and/or execute a focused scholarly research agenda
  • Produce peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations
  • Pursue funding opportunities to support research and scholarship

Service

  • Participate in school and institutional service
  • Engage in professional and community service activities

Required Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree (PhD or DSW) in Social Work or related field by time of appointment
  • MSW from a CSWE-accredited program
  • Demonstrated ability or potential for effective teaching, research, and scholarship that aligns with the school’s needs, mission, vision, and guiding philosophy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Excellent teaching evaluations and experience teaching online
  • At least two years post-MSW practice experience and social work licensure

Ao menos uma das seguintes formações:

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).   • Apoiar a gestão de ocorrências e incidentes de SST, realizando registros, levantamentos de informações, participação em investigações, acompanhamento de planos de ação e verificação da implementação das medidas preventivas e corretivas.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação técnica em Segurança do Trabalho, com registro profissional quando aplicável.

Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro.

Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado(a) futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.

Quem somos?

  • Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público‑privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

  • Um supervisor que será responsável por gerenciar e coordenar todas as operações relacionadas ao Serviço de Rouparia dentro do Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Seu principal objetivo é aplicar métodos de Engenharia de Produção, otimização de processos e logística (ex.: Lean) para garantir o fluxo eficiente, o controle estatístico da qualidade, o abastecimento adequado e a máxima produtividade do enxoval hospitalar (limpo e sujo), contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade da assistência e a prevenção de infecções hospitalares.

Dia a dia

  • Supervisionar a equipe do Serviço de Rouparia no desempenho de suas atividades, orientando e treinando‑a no que se fizer necessário.
  • Otimizar e controlar o abastecimento de roupas, dimensionando o enxoval ideal por setor (inventário cíclico e de segurança), utilizando métodos de previsão e planejamento logístico (Forecasting).
  • Interagir com os coordenadores e supervisores das diversas áreas, com a finalidade de acompanhar e avaliar as atividades da equipe de segregação e distribuição do enxoval nos setores.
  • Gerenciar para que as atividades sejam realizadas de acordo com as indicações e orientações do Setor de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar (SCIH), especialmente no manejo do enxoval.
  • Gerenciar os custos operacionais (OPEX), aplicando a análise da causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis) para reduzir perdas (extravios/danos) e otimizar o ciclo de vida do enxoval.
  • Elaborar a escala de trabalho e o cronograma de férias dos colaboradores.
  • Elaborar e gerenciar o cumprimento do Plano de Ação Setorial, desenvolvendo e monitorando indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) como Taxa de Perda, Custo por Peça Processada e Nível de Serviço.
  • Aplicar os Manuais de Boas Práticas estabelecidos, o Manual de Acreditação ONA 2014 e o RAG - Requisitos de Apoio à Gestão.
  • Prover a gerência de informações por meio de relatórios analíticos e dashboards que subsidiem tomadas de decisões estratégicas e baseadas em dados (data‑driven).
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento do contrato de Interação de Processos.
  • Avaliar a equipe quanto ao desempenho, assiduidade, pontualidade e disciplina.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas à área.

Local de trabalho

Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário

8h às 18h de segunda a quinta‑feira | 8h às 17h na sexta‑feira

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo. Altamente desejável em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Processos, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em cargos de supervisão ou liderança, obrigatoriamente em lavanderias hospitalares ou em setor de Rouparia dentro de hospitais.
  • Conhecimento em Ambiente Hospitalar: ter familiaridade com as particularidades do fluxo de enxoval e normas de segurança e higiene (CCIH).
  • Habilidade em gestão de equipes, liderança e comunicação.
  • Capacidade de organização, planejamento e resolução de problemas.

O que vamos amar se você tiver

  • Pós‑graduação em áreas relacionadas à Gestão Hospitalar, Qualidade ou áreas afins.
  • Vivência ou conhecimento em metodologias de Melhoria Contínua (PDCA, DMAIC) e ferramentas de Qualidade (ex.: 5S, Six Sigma).
  • Habilidade intermediária/avançada em Excel/Power BI para modelagem e análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre tipos de enxoval, controle de estoque e ciclo de vida da roupa hospitalar.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão da qualidade.

Benefícios

Alimentação : VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.

Saúde : Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem‑estar físico e mental.

Finanças : Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.

Day off no aniversário : Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.

Convênio com SESC : Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager the Ticketing Stadium Configuration Manager will help building and maintaining stadium seating maps for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Working in close collaboration with the Configuration and Inventory team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for the management of ticketing inventory, seating plans and its maintenance in the Ticketing System, ensuring data accuracy throughout the planning phase and during the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the central liaison to FIFA Zurich, facilitating alignment on strategic priorities, reporting, and operational updates
  • Provide hands‑on support and guidance to the local team, ensuring they have the resources, information, and leadership needed to deliver high‑quality operational outcomes
  • Support and build accurate seating plans in the ticketing system for FIFA tournament venues of the host country
  • Manage and oversee the implementation of all necessary seating information and configuration of spectator flows, price categories, seat allocations and carry out required updates
  • Maintain on day‑to‑day basis seating maps and configurations within the ticketing system throughout all stages of FIFA tournaments and apply changes as required
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy of all seating information and configuration
  • Evaluate outcomes of quality inspections and proposes corrective measures
  • Carry out the seat allocation and seat assignment process in the ticketing system
  • Assess and analyse maps and plans of FIFA tournament venues to identify gaps and changes to be applied in the seating plans and configurations
  • Plan, prepare and carry out onsite seat inspection visits to fully validate seating plans as built in the ticketing system with the actual venue seating
  • Support the overall management of ticketing inventory by conducting quality assurance measure for both ticket quotas and seat allocations
  • Administer allocations and additional ticket requests during the tournaments
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events

YOUR PROFILE

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor degree or similar level of education
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (preferably Secutix)
  • 5 years of professional experience
  • 1-3 years of experience in ticketing or similar functional area (first experiences in creating seating maps or floorplans in a software application of advantage)
  • Experience in data analytics and/ or management
  • Onsite ticketing operations experience
  • Experience in working with CAD technical drawings
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Sharepoint, Teams, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently, managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to coordinate across functional areas such as security, broadcasting, hospitality
  • Strong analytical skills, detail‑oriented, technology minded, efficient and accountable team player
  • Ability to adapt to working with different environment and time zones

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Missão do Cargo

Atuar de forma plena nas análises dos processos operacionais inerentes ao setor de GRO, com o objetivo de manter níveis adequados à segurança ocupacional nos ambientes laborais, aos colaboradores de sua empresa, face a legislação vigente.

  • Contribuir com o cumprimento das normas legais e boas práticas, relacionadas a Segurança Ocupacional, face a legislação vigente por meio da análise técnica da aplicação das ferramentas de Saúde e Segurança Ocupacional, conforme disposto na legislação vigente e demais normas técnicas de referência;

  • Contribuir para com a participação dos colaboradores, nas ações de Segurança Ocupacional, por meio do engajamento junto as Comissões Internas de Prevenção de Acidentes (CIPA) e demais gestões da companhia;
  • Contribuir com a composição de defesa, nas demandas em inquéritos civis e processos trabalhistas, junto ao setor jurídico, através da organização e disponibilização de documentos relacionados a Segurança Ocupacional, que se façam necessários.

Formação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho;

Domínio em Pacote Office: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook;

Domínio em Ferramentas de Segurança Ocupacional (PGR, LTI, LTP, LTCAT, AET), entre outras;

Domínio em Rotinas de Segurança Ocupacional (CIPAA, BVE, CAT, PPP, SIPAT, Campanhas Internas), entre outras.

Domínio em Sistemas de Segurança Ocupacional (eSocial);

Desejado: Power BI;

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage the development and delivery of key Sustainability Strategy initiatives to:

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023™ Sustainability Team:

  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

YOUR PROFILE

Minimum requirements:

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices;
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights;
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes;
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments;
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes;
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication; and
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an advantage:

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations;
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events;
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition;
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards;
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders;
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications;
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique knowledge and skills:

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe;
  • Self-motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate;
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written);
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills;
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds; and
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio-political and sustainability issues.

You can expect a highly knowledgeable, motivated and helpful team working in a dynamic multicultural environment.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to assigned Host City for the Tournament operational period.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as a Site Leader. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer. We are a combination of operations and support teams covering aligned to innovate for the last mile customer experience. Come build the future with us!

  • Support, mentor, and motivate your team

  • Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
  • Collaborate with all support teams including (but not limited to) Safety, Ops Integration, Loss Prevention and PXT to develop plans to meet business objectives
  • Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
  • Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
  • Work a flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
  • Experience in Business English skills, both verbal and written
  • Experience in managing teams

Preferred Qualifications

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.
